provenance: Claude-authored training task (claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-24); kept only after container verification. Not development or held-out data.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt:
The section file sections/custom-liquid-block.liquid renders merchant-supplied Liquid, but its {% schema %} block has several problems:
- The code field uses the wrong setting type.
- Some defaults are the wrong type or are not valid option values.
- A range step is wrong.
- The padding header, the group restriction and the preset are missing.

Rewrite ONLY the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block. Keep the markup above it byte-for-byte. The schema must be exactly the following (object key order is irrelevant; array order matters).

Top level:
- "name": "Custom Liquid"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section-custom-liquid"
- "disabled_on": an object whose only key is "groups", with value ["header", "footer"] in that order.

"settings" (exactly these six entries, in this order):
1. type "liquid", id "custom_liquid", label "Custom Liquid", info "Add app snippets or other Liquid code to create advanced customizations." (no default).
2. type "checkbox", id "full_width", label "Full page width", default false. This must be the JSON boolean false, not a string.
3. type "select", id "background", label "Background". options in order: {value "none", label "None"}, {value "light", label "Light"}, {value "dark", label "Dark"}. default "none" (the option value, not its label).
4. type "header", content "Section padding" (no id, no label).
5. type "range", id "padding_top", label "Top padding", min 0, max 120, step 8, unit "px", default 40.
6. type "range", id "padding_bottom", label "Bottom padding", min 0, max 120, step 8, unit "px", default 40.

"presets": exactly one preset, whose only key is "name" with value "Custom Liquid".

The section has no blocks: omit the "blocks" and "max_blocks" keys. No other keys may appear anywhere. Change only sections/custom-liquid-block.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
